text:
ana: Quick FYI — ran a hybrid AWQ+GPTQ bakeoff on calendar extraction (calendar.csv). Seeing CSV column header swap / column collapse with some INT8 AWQ configs. Repro steps and sample diff below. cc @mike @eva

mike: can you paste the smallest failing example? sounds like prefix-padding/tokenalignment issue we've seen before

ana: repro command:
```
python run_bakeoff.py --model rwl-7b --quant awq-int8 --fallback gptq-4bit --dataset datasets/calendar.csv --seed 7 --batch_size 8 --pad_to_multiple_of 64 --kv_cache yes
```
sample diff (fp32 vs awq-int8):
```diff
-fp32: Date,Title,Location
-fp32: 2024-03-12,All hands,Room A
-awq:  Date,Location,Title
-awq: 2024-03-12,Room A,All hands
```
metrics: CSV-column-align accuracy: fp32=98.6%  awq-int8=95.3% (drop ~3.3%)

eva: interesting. was kv cache enabled for the fp32 run too? and is this with streaming or full response?

ana: kv_cache=on for both, full response mode. streaming didn't change the failure. prefix_padding=true (we purposely padded to 64).

lee: try seed=0 and batch_size=1 — if it goes away that's a batch/seed dependent quant noise issue

ana: ran batch_size=1 seed=0 -> formatting delta reduced to ~1.2% but still shows occasional header swaps. single-row example that still fails: `2024-03-12,All hands,Room A` -> `2024-03-12,Room A,All hands`

priyanka: could be tokenization boundary + prefix cache interaction. try --no-prefix-cache and compare

ana: reran with --no-prefix-cache -> GPTQ path OK, AWQ still swaps ~0.7% of rows. grepped logs, AWQ branch shows repeated message: `decode_step: token_realign=true` right before comma tokens.

mike: run a focused comparison: fp32 vs awq-int8 vs fp8 (if available) for same prompts and print raw token ids for the swapped rows. also include run with pad_to_multiple_of=1 (no padding)

ana: fp8 and fp32 both produce correct ordering on same prompts. so issue seems AWQ-specific. token id traces for a failing row (AWQ):
```
... 71 44  102  12  (71=digits,44=comma,102=quote)
post-softmax spike at id 44 shifted decoder pointer by +1 in a few steps
```

devops-bot: deploy-bakeoff-2024-03-10: job 6421 finished; logs and artifacts: s3://redwood-bakeoffs/6421/ (artifacts: token_traces.tar.gz, run_manifest.json)

eva: let's bisect AWQ runtime flags: first try disableAdaptiveRounding=true, then test disableBiasCorrection and fallbackQuantizeKernels=false. also repro with pad_to_multiple_of=32 and 1

ana: will run those combos in parallel; ETA ~2hrs. if reproducible we'll open a canary, tag eng-runtime + eng-ml, and add a test to the eval harness to catch CSV-column reordering regressions (small dataset of ~200 rows).

mike: also add a quick diff check in the console that alerts when comma-separated token groups re-order for structured outputs. :eyes:

ana: noted — I'll post results here when the runs finish (attaching short logs to s3 artifact).
